title: Upsert to delta table with Lakehouse connector (Preview)

content.text: We've added upsert support to the Lakehouse connector, allowing direct writes to Delta tables, in both Copy job and Copy activity within Pipeline. For more information, see Configure Lakehouse in a copy activity.
